entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01. 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Addl.
Standing counsel for the State.

3. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with 1CC No. 131 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned JMFC, Basta, Balasore for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 498A/302/340B/326A/326B/34 of IPC.

4. Such apprehension is because of the fact that summons has been issued by the court below for his appearance, this court is unable to accept the contention of learned counsel for the petitioner that he may be taken into custody on his appearance.
Had such been the intention of the court below, it would have issued a warrant instead of summons.

The anticipatory bail application is therefore,
disposed of directing the petitioner to appear in pursuance of the summon so issued.
6. Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
(Sashikanta Mishra) Judge deepak Saroj Patra vs State Of Odisha ....
